Dates estimated occurring earlier date. NULL (default), determined earliest date data date_buffer. latest_possible_date latest possible date (YYYY-MM-DD format). Dates estimated occurring later date. NULL (default), determined latest date data date_buffer. date_buffer date buffer terms days determine earliest /latest possible dates data. earliest_possible_date specified earliest possible date taken date_buffer days earliest date data. Similarly, latest_possible_date specified latest possible date taken date_buffer days latest date data. prob_update_estimated_dates probability proposing update estimated date iteration MCMC prob_update_error_indicators probability proposing update error indicator (corresponding estimated date updated accordingly) iteration MCMC prob_error_swap probability proposing swap errors non-errors vice versa (excluding missing dates) individuals least one error non-error iteration MCMC
